headline: Iran and Oman Agree on New Strait of Hormuz Route; Trump Threatens Bombing If Deal Disrupts US Negotiations
summary: Iran and Oman agreed on a new route through the Strait of Hormuz. US President Trump threatened bombing if the deal disrupts US-Iran negotiations.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world's most important oil transit chokepoints. Changes to its shipping routes or tensions there can affect crude supply and prices.
why_moved: The new route agreement and Trump's threat of bombing bear on Hormuz shipping, which is a key crude oil route. The input notes US-Iran negotiations remain an obstacle to reopening it.
